title: W10864849 — Service Test Mode
description: Enter Service Test Mode via 2nd diagnostic button; select functions with Soil Level/Temperature; START toggles loads.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 6.2 cu ft Direct Drive Top Load Washer

steps.title: Enter Service Test Mode
steps.body: With Service Diagnostic mode active, press and release the 2nd button used for diagnostic entry. POWER and START indicators: START flashes. Use Soil Level (+) or Temperature (−) to select function number (001–018, 051 verification cycle, 052 load calibration). Press START to toggle selected function on/off — flashing display = function active. Max four functions on simultaneously. POWER exits to standby.
steps.sourceExcerpt: To enter Service Test Mode, press and release the 2nd button used to activate the Service Diagnostic mode.
